name: maxp-portal-mobile
description: Consolidated multi-flavor thin Capacitor mobile shell for MaxP portals

scripts.build:parent:debug: node scripts/configure-shell.cjs --flavor=parent && cd android && gradlew assembleParentDebug
scripts.build:portal:debug: node scripts/configure-shell.cjs --flavor=portal && cd android && gradlew assemblePortalDebug
scripts.build:courier:debug: node scripts/configure-shell.cjs --flavor=courier && cd android && gradlew assembleCourierDebug
scripts.build:customer:debug: node scripts/configure-shell.cjs --flavor=customer && cd android && gradlew assembleCustomerDebug
